column2: To qualify for the Contra Payment Facility, you must have: Booked a flat and received an invitation to collect the keys Applied to sell your existing flat Fully redeemed your housing loan of your existing flat, if the loan is provided by a financial institution (FI) You must be: Eligible for a housing loan from HDB, and are using it for your flat purchase Able to cover the full purchase price of the flat using the following funds: CPF Ordinary Account balance Cash and CPF proceeds from the sale of your existing flat. You may retain up to $20,000 from the CPF refund. Maximum housing loan from HDB that you are eligible for following credit assessment If the funds above are insufficient, you must be able to top up the shortfall within the time period HDB provides, before the request for the Contra Payment Facility can be approved
If you wish to apply for Contra Payment Facility, please submit the request when you apply to sell your existing flat.
